content:
Hi all,

Happy to share https://github.com/kmehltretter82/foundations-of-computation-lean

Standalone Lean 4 formalization of the Foundations of Computation textbook, not relying on Mathlib. Includes a Verso site.

It covers the book from logic, sets, and induction through automata, grammars, and Turing machines to undecidability, with no Mathlib dependency. Currently more than 500K lines of Lean 4.

This made heavy use of AI coding agents. Now with no sorrys and no axiom declarations. Probably cleanup and improvements will be done in the future.

Happy about any feedback.
Maybe something here you are really sure about yourself could be contributed to CSLib?

While I guided the AI and made suggestions when it was really stuck on Chapter 5 computablity, I did not go very low detail, so I am not really confident. But I learned a lot about Lean and using AI. The latest AI model releases in July also helped finish Chapter 5 foundation proofs.

I thought about contributing to cslib before starting this project. This project was more to quickly learn and try new AI tooling. Maybe I can contribute to cslib in the future.

I am also thinking about doing a similar standalone project to this, focused on complexity theory.
